item.title: Over 5 million visitors tallied at Wyoming State Parks in 2025
item.description: WYOMING — State Parks in Wyoming saw over 5 million visitors in 2025, marking the highest visitation levels since the recreation surge of 2020 and 2021. Wyoming State Parks announced in a news release on Tuesday that the agency saw 5,048,419 visitors at state-managed parks last year, which is a 5% increase over 2024.
